fields.label: Rule Code
fields.description: Unique short identifier within this plan (e.g. DISC01). Tier rows link to it.

fields.label: Discount Name
fields.description: Business meaning, e.g. Trade Discount, Quarterly Support, Annual Target Incentive.

fields.label: Calculation Type
fields.description: Percentage: sales × rate; Fixed Amount: a fixed amount once/monthly; Tiered: choose threshold based on monthly, quarterly or annual planned sales.

fields.label: Discount %
fields.description: Percentage of eligible planned sales; relevant only when Calculation Type is Percentage.

fields.label: Fixed Amount (Base)
fields.description: Amount in company base currency. Can repeat monthly or be applied only once.

fields.label: Fixed Frequency
fields.description: Monthly = once each applicable month; Once = only one time in the first applicable sales month.

fields.label: Tier Target Period
fields.description: Monthly: test each month; Quarterly: combine each calendar quarter; Annual: combine full fiscal year before choosing a tier.

fields.label: Tier Calculation Method
fields.description: Whole Band: selected tier percentage applies to all eligible sales; Progressive: percentages apply separately to portions of sales in each band.

fields.label: Calculation Base
fields.description: Before Item Discount uses gross planned item values; After Item Discount uses item revenue after existing planned line discount. Does not deduct other commercial rules.
fields.options:
Before Item Discount
After Item Discount

fields.label: Applicable Items
fields.description: All Items includes all budget items; Item Group or Item limits the eligible base. Fixed amounts are not affected by this filter.

fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Only the selected item group is included when Applicable Items = Item Group.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: Only the selected item is included when Applicable Items = Item.

fields.description: With Sales Collection: discount follows eligible sales to their planned collection month; Specific Month: discount reduces collection in the selected month/year once.
